L11@P0: Announcement Regarding the Execution of a Product Commercialization Agreement with
L12@P0: EVERSANA Life Science Services, LLC for the U.S. Market
L13@P0: Innovacell Inc. (the “Company”) hereby announces that, at the meeting of the Board of Directors held
L14@P0: today, it resolved to enter into a Product Commercialization Agreement (the “Agreement”) with
L15@P0: EVERSANA Life Science Services, LLC (“EVERSANA”) regarding ICEF15, the Company’s
L16@P0: development product, a cell therapy product targeting urge fecal incontinence. Through the Agreement,
L17@P0: the Company will retain ownership of the product rights for ICEF15 in the U.S. market while achieving
L18@P0: a rapid and efficient launch in the global market, and will seek to maximize its business value.
L19@P0: 1. Background for the Agreement
L20@P0: The Company is currently developing its sales and marketing infrastructure in the U.S. market in
L21@P0: preparation for the global rollout of ICEF15. EVERSANA is a global company specializing in the
L22@P0: commercialization of pharmaceuticals and regenerative medicine products, with a proven track
L23@P0: record of providing integrated services across the entire commercialization process, from
L24@P0: preparation for regulatory filings through post-launch market expansion. To date, its
L25@P0: commercialization model has been adopted by more than 20 companies, including regenerative
L26@P0: medicine companies, and it has supported the commercialization of more than 40 pharmaceutical
L27@P0: or regenerative medicine products worldwide. In terms of its track record, through engagement
L28@P0: with EVERSANA, quantitative outcomes have been demonstrated, including over approximately
L29@P0: 20% average reductions in commercialization-related costs, improved reach to healthcare
L30@P0: institutions, and revenue generation exceeding business plan projections. The Company has
L31@P0: previously engaged EVERSANA to conduct market and business feasibility assessments of
L32@P0: ICEF15 in the United States and has thereby deepened mutual understanding between the two
L33@P0: parties. Based on a comprehensive evaluation of (i) EVERSANA’s advanced expertise in
L34@P0: pharmaceutical commercialization, (ii) its extensive track record in the field of regenerative
L35@P0: medicine products, and (iii) the high degree of alignment in strategic direction and economic
L36@P0: incentives with the Company, the Company has determined that EVERSANA is the optimal
L37@P0: partner for the commercialization of ICEF15 in the U.S. market and has therefore decided to enter
L38@P0-1: into the Agreement.2
L39@P1: 2. Overview of the Counterparty (as of July 23, 2026)
L40@P1: (1) N a m e EVERSANA Life Science Services, LLC
L41@P1: (2) A d d r e s s 7045 College Boulevard, Overland Park, KS 66211, United States
L42@P1: (3) R e p r e s e n t a t i v e Mark Thierer, Chief Executive Officer
L43@P1: (4) B u s i n e s s
L44@P1: Commercialization support services for the life sciences industry
L45@P1: (consulting, marketing, distribution, patient support, etc.)
L46@P1: (5) URL https://www.eversana.com/
L47@P1: 3. Overview of the Agreement
L48@P1: This agreement covers the commercialization activities for ICEF15 in the United States, under
L49@P1: which we will primarily outsource the following functions by leveraging EVERSANA’s existing
L50@P1: infrastructure as a pharmaceutical commercialization specialist.
L51@P1: ⚫ Commercialization activities relating to ICEF15, including:
L52@P1: ◼ Pre-launch strategy development
L53@P1: - Market data and analytics
L54@P1: - Market access
L55@P1: - Development and support of supply chain and distribution systems
L56@P1: - Deployment and management of sales representatives and field teams
L57@P1: ◼ Patient engagement
L58@P1: ⚫ Agency engagement and management
L59@P1: ⚫ Other activities related to commercialization
L60@P1: Unlike a traditional license-out model in which rights in the U.S. market are granted to third
L61@P1: parties, this Agreement adopts a hybrid collaboration structure under which the Company retains
L62@P1: ownership of product rights and assets for ICEF15 in the market while leveraging EVERSANA’s
L63@P1: commercialization infrastructure. The Company and EVERSANA plan to establish a joint
L64@P1: management committee to conduct regular reviews of strategy, budgets, and performance,
L65@P1: thereby ensuring ongoing optimization of the business. In addition, under the Agreement, a
L66@P1: portion of the service fees payable by the Company to EVERSANA is subject to deferred payment
L67@P1: on an interest-free basis, and a mechanism has been incorporated whereby such fees are
L68@P1: recovered based on the outcomes of the services provided. This structure directly aligns
L69@P1: EVERSANA’s economic incentives with the Company’s business performance and is a key
L70@P1: feature of the Agreement, establishing a collaboration model in which the strategic objectives and
L71@P1: economic interests of both parties are closely aligned, with shared risks and returns.
L72@P1: The collaboration under the Agreement is expected to generate the following benefits:
L73@P1: (1) Benefits for the Company
L74@P1: ⚫ Retention of ownership of product rights and assets related to ICEF15 in the U.S. market
L75@P1: ⚫ Recognition of product sales in the Company’s top-line revenue and achievement of
L76@P1: relatively higher profit margins
L77@P1: ⚫ Reduction of initial capital expenditure and operating expenses associated with
L78@P1: commercialization through the utilization of EVERSANA’s commercialization
L79@P1: infrastructure
L80@P1-2: ⚫ Rapid establishment of a commercialization framework in the U.S. market3
L81@P2: (2) Benefits for EVERSANA
L82@P2: ⚫ Expansion of business opportunities through involvement in the Company’s development
L83@P2: pipeline
L84@P2: ⚫ Strengthening of its commercialization track record in the high-growth regenerative
L85@P2: medicine sector
L86@P2: ⚫ Acquisition of royalty income linked to the net sales of ICEF15
L87@P2: (3) Mutual Benefits
L88@P2: ⚫ Establishment of a collaboration model based on shared risk and return
L89@P2: ⚫ Strengthening of a strategic partnership aimed at long-term business growth
L90@P2: 4. Scheduled Date
L91@P2: Date of Board Resolution July 23, 2026 (Today)
L92@P2: Date of Agreement
L93@P2: Execution(Planned)
L94@P2: July 23, 2026 (Today)
L95@P2: 5. Future Outlook
L96@P2: This matter has already been incorporated into the Company’s consolidated financial forecast for
L97@P2: the fiscal year ending December 31, 2026. Should any events arise that materially impact the
L98@P2: Company’s financial performance, the Company will promptly disclose such information.
L99@P2: 6. Message from the Representative Directors
L100@P2: Innovacell Inc.
L101@P2: Colin Novick, Representative Director Co-CEO
L102@P2: Jason Sieger, Representative Director Co-CEO
L103@P2: The development of ICEF15, the Company’s lead product, has entered its final stage, and we are
L104@P2: now at a critical juncture where we should commence building the infrastructure necessary to
L105@P2: deliver ICEF15-based treatment to patients. EVERSANA, as a global company specializing in the
L106@P2: commercialization of pharmaceuticals and regenerative medicine products, possesses industryleading expertise and a strong track record. The Company has highly evaluated such expertise,
L107@P2: as well as the strong strategic alignment with EVERSANA, and has selected EVERSANA as the
L108@P2: optimal partner for the commercialization of ICEF15 in the U.S. market. Under the Agreement, by
L109@P2: leveraging EVERSANA’s global commercialization platform and broad expertise, we believe that
L110@P2: a rapid and efficient expansion of ICEF15 in the U.S. market can be achieved. EVERSANA
L111@P2: provides integrated solutions ranging from strategic planning to market entry, sales and
L112@P2: distribution, and patient access support, and we expect that it will be a highly capable partner in
L113@P2: maximizing the value of ICEF15. Furthermore, this Agreement goes beyond a simple service
L114@P2: arrangement and constitutes the foundation of a strategic partnership aimed at sustainable
L115@P2: growth, in which both parties’ strategic objectives and economic incentives are aligned through
L116@P2: mechanisms such as partial deferral of service fees, enabling the sharing of risks and returns.As
L117@P2: a partner with whom we share a common vision, the Company will continue to explore further
L118@P2-3: opportunities to expand this collaboration. We look forward to the future progress together.4
L119@P3: EVERSANA Life Science Services, LLC
L120@P3: Gregory Skalicky, President
L121@P3: Cell and gene therapies represent one of the most transformative advancements in medicine, but
L122@P3: they also require a fundamentally different commercialization approach. Innovacell has built an
L123@P3: impressive pipeline grounded in cutting-edge science designed to improve patients’ lives. We
L124@P3: share this purpose and look forward to working with their team to accelerate worldwide access to
L125@P3: new patient treatments through our commercialization platform.
L126@P3: End
